newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank drains SKK1.8bln in rev repo tenders.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank drains SKK1.8bln in rev repo tenders.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said it drained funds totalling 1.77 billion crowns ($54.3 million) through two securities reverse repurchase tenders on Wednesday.
In the NBS's one-day reverse repo tender, the average rate rose to 17.4 percent, up from 17.03 percent in the previous reverse repo tender of a similar maturity on Tuesday.
In the seven-day tender, the first at such a maturity this year, the average rate was 17.00 percent.

The NBS noted the one-day tender was oversubscribed, with 1.17 billion crowns worth of bids from a total of 1.73 billion being accepted. In the seven-day tender, all bids totalling 600 million crowns were accepted.
The NBS holds tenders on a daily basis, if needed.
